long_biography.plain_text:
Seth Campbell helped move BBC International beyond the children's footwear market in which his father, Robert, had built the company. His exposure began early, including a summer working in a Chinese factory at 13. After studying at New York University and a footwear school in Milan, he joined BBC in international sales and developed its Champion licensing partnership.

As corporate president, Campbell works alongside chief executive Josue Solano across a portfolio of owned brands and licensed footwear. The family company now combines design, sourcing and global distribution, with products spanning athletic, lifestyle and luxury categories. He also serves on the board of the Two Ten Footwear Foundation, a longstanding industry charity.
